title: Tell the user a newer release is out and update from the UI
notes:
The app tells you a newer release is out and updates itself from the UI, with no rebuild. There is no website: the source is GitHub's releases API (https://api.github.com/repos/naeemba/dashboard/releases/latest, public, no token; unauthenticated limit 60 an hour, so a check on launch and every 6 hours is far under it).

1. Check: on launch and every 6 hours, read the latest release. If its version is newer than the running build's version (compare the semver only; the +<commit> stamp is ignored, so a local build of main ahead of the tag never nags), show a notice: "Dashboard vX.Y.Z is out" with Update and What's new (the release notes, in the what's-new popup #220 already draws). A failed check is silent apart from a log line.
2. Update: download the release asset for this platform into the user data folder, verify its size against the asset, stage it, then show "Restart to update". The app restarts only when the user picks that row (never on its own: workflow-rule-1 is about agents, the user choosing is the point).
   - Linux: the linux-x64 zip, unpacked to a staging folder, swapped into ~/.local/opt/dashboard the way scripts/rebuild.sh swaps (same stamp check before the swap), launcher left as is.
   - Windows: Squirrel's Update.exe pointed at the GitHub release (RELEASES and the nupkg are already uploaded by release.yml); works unsigned.
   - macOS arm64: the darwin zip, replacing the app bundle, then clearing com.apple.quarantine. Electron's autoUpdater refuses unsigned mac builds, so this is a hand-made swap; if Gatekeeper still blocks it, say so in the notice and link the README's Install steps.
3. Settings: a row to turn the check off; a key (an action in src/shared/keys/actions.ts, keys-rule-2) and the help line for "check for updates now".

Every state change (check, download, stage, swap, restart) goes through an action, src/main/actions/update/ (actions-rule-1). Decisions (newer or not, which asset, when to check) in small modules with tests (workflow-rule-2). Refusals explained where decided (errors-rule-1), IPC refusals as values (errors-rule-2). Keyboard first for the notice rows (conventions-rule-1).

Hand check: install an older release, launch, see the notice, update, restart into the new one, on Linux at least; Windows and macOS if a machine is at hand. Docs: a new docs/updates feature folder (README, hard rules, decisions, history), the README's Install section, docs index.

comments.body: Shipped in #246: a status bar notice when a newer GitHub release is out, a Ctrl+Shift+G dialog (Update, Restart to update, What's new), the Linux and macOS zip swap and Squirrel on Windows, all through update.* actions, and an Updates settings row written through settings:write (settings.write had not landed). Hand-checked on Linux by swapping the real v2.44.0 into a throwaway folder. The relaunch, Windows and macOS are not checked.
